content.title: Cameron Young's Children Don't Have Any Idea About His Big Wins, He Once Revealed Their Interest
content.text: The famous American golfer, Cameron Young, is leading all the headlines for his recent performance in the Masters Tournament. While many believe that he will be taking another trophy back home, not many know that his children are unfazed by his stardom and success. Once Cameron revealed his children's true interest when they came to see his game. Cameron Young on how his children had no idea about his wins Cameron Young is happily married to his wife, Kelsey Daliton, who runs his empire while he is away playing tournaments and following his dream. The couple are blessed with three children; their first child, Henry, was born in 2022. Later, in 2023, the couple was blessed with another baby boy, whom they named John. The couple's family was completed with the arrival of their youngest daughter, whom they have named Vivienne. The family often travels together and even attends Cameron's matches. However, his children are not interested in his game or the trophies he brings home. In March 2026, Cameron Young won the 2026 Players Championship, which was his second big win on the PGA Tour. The celebration was even more special because his family was there to see him win, making the milestone even more joyous. After the match, Cameron shared his happiness with the media and how it was amazing to celebrate the occasion with his family by his side. Cameron was dreaming of the moment to celebrate it with his family and run to them with the trophy in his hand. The 28-year-old golf star revealed that to hug his boys and see his wife and daughter after the big win was super special and a moment that will stay in his memory for a long, long time. While the win is special for Cameron Young, his children seemed unfazed by his bringing the trophy home. During the press interaction, Cameron revealed that his children were more interested in the drone that was flying rather than the trophy he held. He was quoted as saying: Continue reading below "There's a lot going on out there. My kids are more interested in the drone than the trophy, which I think is a really nice bit of perspective on a day like today. But yeah, really thankful to have them here." Cameron further revealed that his children, who are too young to understand what he does for a living, have no idea about it. He added that it is a blessing that they have no clue about his success, as they just get happy to see him at the end of the day. They just don't care what trophy he has in his hands. He added that the way his children see him holds top priority in his life. He said: "They have absolutely no idea. Honestly, it's a blessing because they're just happy to see me at the end of the day. They don't care that I'm holding the Players trophy. In a sense, it's an incredible perspective just to know that this is amazing and I'm incredibly grateful to have played the way I did and won. But they're what's important and the way they view me is more important than anything." More about Cameron Young and his wife, Kelsey Daliton It was in 2019, when Cameron Young became a pro. In 2021, Cameron got married to his longtime girlfriend, Kelsey. The same year, he was named the PGA Tour Rookie of the Year in 2022, and he secured his first win in 2025. Cameron often gives credit for his success to his wife, Kelsey. He acknowledges her presence in his life and how she manages his home while he is busy chasing his dreams.
